read_keys: transaction-email.v1, access fingerprint, operation, operation reference
warming: open-only; private records never load on public hover
retained_answer: shared access-partitioned memory; locale is excluded from keys; an error hides retained private results
refresh: show the current answer while its bounded read refreshes; no delivery action is retried
first_frame: shared page header and row skeletons before the first answer; existing root theme, fonts and shell
arrival: one shared AnswerArrival per access scope; reduced motion and keyboard follow the shared recipe
pagination: bounded offset, maximum 100000; server limit maximum 50
composition: shared page-read provider and shell only; route registry composition belongs to its existing owner
composition_unavailable: Route entry remains unmounted until the composition owner registers the delivery contract and shared shell.
